ARTROLLER-LOAD_PERSONAL_EDITS.title: Load Personal Edits
ARTROLLER-LOAD_PERSONAL_EDITS.hover.desc:
Shows the art you saved with the editor. Turn it off to see cards exactly as their mods ship them; your saved edits are kept and come back when you turn it on again.

Always on while Personal Edit Mode or Developer Mode is on.
ARTROLLER-PERSONAL_EDIT_MODE.title: Personal Edit Mode
ARTROLLER-PERSONAL_EDIT_MODE.hover.desc: Adds colour, mirror and portrait controls beside a card inspected in the Card Library. Works on any card you have discovered, base game or modded. Rolls you save there apply only on this computer and override the card's normal art.
ARTROLLER-DEVELOPER_MODE.title: Developer Mode
ARTROLLER-DEVELOPER_MODE.hover.desc: For mod authors. Everything in Personal Edit Mode, plus Save Default, which writes rolls into a folder you choose so you can ship them with your mod, and a label showing the key each save writes to.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_HUE.title: Hue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_HUE.desc: Rotates every colour around the colour wheel. 0 and 100 are both unchanged; 50 swaps each colour for its opposite.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SATURATION.title: Saturation
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SATURATION.desc: Colour intensity. 0 is greyscale, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_LUMINANCE.title: Luminance
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_LUMINANCE.desc: Brightness. 50 halves it, 100 is unchanged, 150 is one and a half times as bright.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED.title: Red
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED.desc: Multiplies the red in the art. 0 removes it, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN.title: Green
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN.desc: Multiplies the green in the art. 0 removes it, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE.title: Blue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE.desc: Multiplies the blue in the art. 0 removes it, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CONTRAST.title: Contrast
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CONTRAST.desc: Pushes darks and lights apart around mid-grey. Below 100 flattens the art, above 100 sharpens it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TINT.title: Tint
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TINT.desc: Multiplies the whole image by a colour. White is unchanged; any other colour washes the art toward it and can only darken, never brighten.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GAMMA.title: Gamma
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GAMMA.desc: Darkens or lifts the midtones while leaving pure black and white alone. Below 100 brightens the midtones, above 100 darkens them.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED_OFFSET.title: Red Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED_OFFSET.desc: Adds or removes red evenly across the art, including in the shadows, which the Red slider cannot reach. 100 is unchanged.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN_OFFSET.title: Green Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN_OFFSET.desc: Adds or removes green evenly across the art, including in the shadows, which the Green slider cannot reach. 100 is unchanged.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE_OFFSET.title: Blue Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE_OFFSET.desc: Adds or removes blue evenly across the art, including in the shadows, which the Blue slider cannot reach. 100 is unchanged.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_STANDARD.title: Standard
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_STANDARD.desc:
Adjustments that apply to the whole image: tint, hue, colour balance, contrast and flips.

Order of operations: this tab applies first, as Red, Green and Blue with their offsets, then Hue, Sat and Lum, then Contrast, Gamma and Tint. The Selective Hue sets then work on the result.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_SELECTIVE.title: Selective Hue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_SELECTIVE.desc:
Up to three sets that each change only one colour in the art, such as turning a blue flame purple while leaving everything else alone.

Order of operations: these apply after everything on the Standard tab, then Set 1, Set 2 and Set 3 in turn. Each set works on the art as the sets above it left it, which is exactly what you see on the card.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_TARGET.title: Selective Hue: Target
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_TARGET.desc:
The colour this set changes. Only its hue counts, so darker and paler versions of it are caught too.

To target a colour straight from the card, click the swatch, press the eyedropper button in the colour picker, then click that pixel in the card's art. The eyedropper reads the art as it is currently shown, which is what this set matches against, so pick before you shift it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_WIDTH.title: Selective Hue: Width
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_WIDTH.desc: How close to the target a colour must be to change. Low catches only that exact hue; 100 reaches a quarter of the colour wheel either side. 0 turns this set off.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SHIFT.title: Selective Hue: Shift
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SHIFT.desc: Rotates only the targeted colours around the colour wheel. 100 is unchanged; 0 and 200 are opposite colours.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SATURATION.de: Mutes or intensifies only the targeted colours. 0 turns them grey, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles their intensity.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_BRIGHTNESS.de: Darkens or lightens only the targeted colours. 0 is black, 100 is unchanged, 200 doubles their brightness.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SOFTNESS.desc: How gradually the change fades out toward the edge of Width. 0 is a hard cutoff, 100 fades all the way from the target colour. Raise it if a recolour leaves a visible fringe.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_RESET.title: Reset Set
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_RESET.desc: Puts this set back to its defaults, which turns it off, as an unsaved preview. The other sets and the Standard tab are left alone.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_X.title: Flip X
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_X.desc: Mirrors the art left to right.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_Y.title: Flip Y
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_Y.desc: Mirrors the art top to bottom.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_COPY.title: Copy
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_COPY.desc: Remembers this card's current settings so you can paste them onto other cards. Copies the colours and flips, not the portrait.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PASTE.title: Paste
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PASTE.desc: Applies the copied settings to this card as a preview. Press Save to keep them.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RESET.title: Reset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RESET.desc: Puts every setting back to neutral and shows the card's original art, as a preview. Nothing is deleted until you Save or Clear.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PORTRAIT.title: Portrait
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PORTRAIT.desc: Replaces this card's art with any other card's. Type part of a name, then pick a result to preview it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE.title: Save
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE.desc:
Saves these settings as your personal roll for this card. Until you save, slider changes are only a preview.

A personal roll applies wherever this card appears, on this computer only. It overrides the card's normal art and survives restarts and mod updates.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR.title: Clear
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR.desc: Deletes your personal roll for this card, so it goes back to its normal art.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE_DEFAULT.title: Save Default
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE_DEFAULT.desc:
Writes these settings as a roll to ship with your mod, into the output folder below.

A personal roll for the same card still wins on your machine. Clear it to see the default.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR_DEFAULT.title: Clear Default
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR_DEFAULT.desc:
Deletes this card's default roll file from the output folder below.

A copy already packed into the mod keeps showing until you rebuild it, and a personal roll for the same card still wins on your machine.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_OUTPUT_FOLDER.title: Output Folder
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_OUTPUT_FOLDER.desc: Where Save Default writes. Point it at your mod's ArtRoller folder in your repo, then rebuild to pack the rolls.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BROWSE.title: Browse
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BROWSE.desc: Choose the folder Save Default writes to. Remembered between sessions.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_UNSAVED.body: You have changed this card's art without saving. Discard those changes?
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_KEY.title: Key
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_KEY.desc: The file name Save and Save Default write to. A key ending in @CHARACTER is a reprint: the roll applies only while that character shows the card, and the original character keeps its own art.
